design: Compare sum of single-source rational laws on actual, six moment and six donor paired interventions. Each control preserves each actual source norm and dot product with pre-MLP residual, but not pair mutual angle or joint effect size. Moment noise generated for all9 heads using original seeds. Donor shift is shared by both heads, preserving donor context coupling before separate angle matching.

gates.joint_formula_audit: max full-panel relative float32 MLP error <.01
gates.actual_replay: max baseline and sum KL difference vs H395 <1e-10
gates.control_unit99: all12 control unit-amplitude joint lower recovery >.99
gates.one_point_equivalence: all24 actual-minus-control simultaneous intervals contained in [-.01,.01]
